newsitem.title: FINLAND: Nokia says to launch "most mobile phone".
newsitem.headline: Nokia says to launch "most mobile phone".

text.p: Finnish telecoms group Nokia Oy said on Wednesday it would launch a new solar-powered version of its 1610 handset, called the 1611, in European GSM markets from the end of January.
In a statement, Nokia called the new model "the most mobile phone under the sun".
The introduction of what Nokia called "the unique solar battery option" would make its 1611 handset "the first product to offer new innovative power management solutions," it said.

Solar batteries, available in volume in April, could be charged with a standard charger "or simply by placing the phone in a sunny place", it said. A solar panel on the back of the phone recharges the battery.

"This benefit, together with the quality and affordability of the product, will ensure the appeal of the Nokia 1611 to broader consumer audiences," Nokia Mobile Phones vice president Anssi Vanjoki said in the statement.
New features for the model, which Nokia targets at a broad consumer market, include mobile originated short message services, Nokia said.
